comments.author: Dana Whitfield
comments.body: Migration script ready for staging; dual-write mapper is in review so old clients keep working during the cutover.

content.text: Migration script ready for staging; dual-write mapper is in review so old clients keep working during the cutover.

Tickets created from the portal use source=portal while email intake uses source=email_inbound, but several reports and macros still look for the legacy tags web and mail. Mixed tags break automation that routes portal tickets to the self-serve queue.

Normalize on portal and email as the only stored source values; migrate existing web→portal and mail→email_inbound rows; update macros and report definitions. Completion criteria: zero open tickets with legacy tags, and the intake dual-write removed after one release of read-compatible mapping.
